DECLARE
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'CLASS'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := rg_name||'.CODE'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := rg_name||'.DESC'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id1 GroupColumn; 
 gc_id2 GroupColumn; 
 v_row_num number:=0; 
 v_tot_no number:=0;
 col_val1 varchar2(5);
 col_val2 varchar2(50);
BEGIN

-------------------------------------
/*** Capturing into a record group*/
-------------------------------------
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 

 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group_Row( rg_id, ALL_ROWS ); 
 End if;
 
 FIRST_RECORD; 
 Loop
 if :ctrl_blk_2.ck_box='Y' then
 v_row_num:=v_row_num+1;
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_char_Cell( rg_col1, v_row_num,:ctrl_blk_2.code); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, v_row_num, :ctrl_blk_2.description); 
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 NEXT_RECORD; 
 End loop;

--------------------------------------
/* populating to valid_acl_codes block */
--------------------------------------
col_val1:=null;
col_val2:=null;

go_block('valid_acl_codes');
last_record;

 begin
 gc_id1 := Find_Column(rg_col1); 
 gc_id2 := Find_Column(rg_col2); 
 
 v_tot_no := Get_Group_Row_Count( rg_id ); 

 FOR i IN 1..v_tot_no LOOP 
 col_val1 := Get_Group_Char_Cell( gc_id1, i ); 
 col_val2 := Get_Group_Char_Cell( gc_id2, i ); 
 
 :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type:=:ctrl_block.acc_type;
 :valid_acl_codes.access_code_value:=col_val1;
 :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des:=col_val2;
 :valid_acl_codes.eff_date:=sysdate;
 create_record; 
 END LOOP; 
end;

----------------
hide_window('window2');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check from database */

 select count(*) into temp from valid_acl_codes where
 access_class=:valid_acl_codes.access_class and 
 access_code_type=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_type and
 access_code_value=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value;

if temp > 0 then
 show_error('0319',:valid_acl_codes.access_class||' '||:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value);
 check_package_failure;
end if;

/* check from buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.type,' ') != nvl(:valid_acl_codes.access_code_type,' ') or
 nvl(:global.value,' ') != nvl(:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('valid_class','C05C05C10',:global.class||','||:global.type||','
 ||:global.value||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('valid_class','C05C05C10',:valid_acl_codes.access_class||','
 ||:valid_acl_codes.access_code_type||','||:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 ||',','C',check_dup);
 
 
 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('valid_class','C05C05C10',:valid_acl_codes.access_class||','
 ||:valid_acl_codes.access_code_type||','||:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 ||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;

/* This procedure should be modified whenever new access code type come in */

PROCEDURE item_validation IS
v_temp Number;
BEGIN
If :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type='INTER' 
then
 /* commented by lakshmi on 3/12/98 */
 /*select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_interdictions where 
 inter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value; */

 begin

 select inter_desc
 into :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des 
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and inter_code not in
 (select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type='INTER');
 exception

 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('12210');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 Elsif :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type='MSTCD' then

 /* select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_master_codes where 
 code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value and code_type='CODTP'; */

 begin 
 select description 
 into :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 and code_type='CODTP'
 and code not in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code 
 and access_code_type='MSTCD');
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('12210');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 Elsif :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type='LETTR' then

 /* select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_letters where 
 letter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value; */
 begin
 select letter_title 
 into :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des 
 from valid_letters 
 where letter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 and letter_code not in
 (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code
 and access_code_type='LETTR');
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('12210');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 Elsif :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type='DRCOM' then

 /* select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from donor_communications where 
 com_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value; */
 begin

 into :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des 
 from donor_communications 
 where com_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 and com_code not in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes

 and access_code_type='DRCOM');

 when no_data_found then

 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;

 Elsif :valid_acl_codes.access_code_type='PROPR' then

 /* select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from valid_interdictions where 
 inter_type='DR' and inter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value; */
 begin 
 select inter_desc 
 into :valid_acl_codes.s_acl_des 
 from valid_interdictions 
 where inter_code=:valid_acl_codes.access_code_value
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code 
 and access_code_type='PROPR'); exception
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('12210');
 check_package_failure; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
End if;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_CODES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE generate_codes(pl_code_type in varchar2) IS
 cursor inter_cur is ---Interdiction cursor
 select inter_code,inter_desc from valid_interdictions where inter_code not in
 ( select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type=pl_code_type)
 and inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where code_type='INTUD' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 order by 1;

 cursor mascd_cur is ----Master codes cursor
 select code ,description from valid_master_codes where code_type='CODTP' and 
 code not in (select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type=pl_code_type)
 order by 1;

 cursor dnrcom_cur is --- Communication cursor
 select com_code,substr(com_desc,1,45) com_des from donor_communications where 
 com_code not in (select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes where 
 access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type=pl_code_type)
 order by 1;

 cursor ltr_cur is ---Letter cursor 
 select letter_code,letter_title from valid_letters where letter_code not in
 (select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type=pl_code_type)
 order by 1;

 cursor dnrpro_cur is ---Donor properties cursor
 select distinct inter_code,inter_desc from valid_interdictions where 
 inter_type in (select code from valid_master_codes where code_type='PROPR' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value from valid_acl_codes
 where access_class=:acl_master.code and access_code_type=pl_code_type)
 order by 1;

 v_code varchar2(5);
 v_des varchar2(50);
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'CLASS'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := rg_name||'.CODE'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := rg_name||'.DESC'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 v_row_num number:=0; 

 BEGIN

 if inter_cur%isopen then
 close inter_cur;
 end if;

 if mascd_cur%isopen then
 close mascd_cur;
 end if;

 if dnrcom_cur%isopen then
 close dnrcom_cur;
 end if;


 if ltr_cur%isopen then
 close ltr_cur;
 end if;

 if dnrpro_cur%isopen then
 close ltr_cur;
 end if;
 
IF pl_code_type='INTER' then
 set_window_property('window2',title,'Interdiction codes'); 
 open inter_cur;
 Loop
 Begin
 Fetch inter_cur into v_code,v_des;
 Exit when inter_cur%notfound;
 :ctrl_blk_2.code:=v_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.description:=v_des;
 create_record;
 end;
 End loop;
 close inter_cur;
 first_record; 

Elsif pl_code_type='MSTCD' then
 set_window_property('window2',title,'Master codes'); 
 open mascd_cur;
 Loop
 Begin
 Fetch mascd_cur into v_code,v_des;
 Exit when mascd_cur%notfound;
 :ctrl_blk_2.code:=v_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.description:=v_des;
 create_record;
 end;
 End loop;
 close mascd_cur;
 first_record; 

Elsif pl_code_type='LETTR' then

 set_window_property('window2',title,'Donor letters'); 
 open ltr_cur;
 Loop
 Begin
 Fetch ltr_cur into v_code,v_des;
 Exit when ltr_cur%notfound;
 :ctrl_blk_2.code:=v_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.description:=v_des;
 create_record;
 end;
 End loop;
 close ltr_cur;
 first_record; 

Elsif pl_code_type='PROPR' then
 set_window_property('window2',title,'Donor properties'); 
 open dnrpro_cur;
 Loop
 Begin
 Fetch dnrpro_cur into v_code,v_des;
 Exit when dnrpro_cur%notfound;
 :ctrl_blk_2.code:=v_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.description:=v_des;
 create_record;
 end;
 End loop;
 close dnrpro_cur;
 first_record; 

Elsif pl_code_type='DRCOM' then
 set_window_property('window2',title,'Donor communicaton codes'); 
 open dnrcom_cur;
 Loop
 Begin
 Fetch dnrcom_cur into v_code,v_des;
 Exit when dnrcom_cur%notfound;
 :ctrl_blk_2.code:=v_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.description:=v_des;
 create_record;
 end;
 End loop;
 close dnrcom_cur;
 first_record; 
end if;
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_2.code',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_2.description',insert_allowed,property_false);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.code');
END;
